description: Measure model's use of hexa via transcript scoring

accepted.by: gary (in conversation, 2026-11-23: "accept the specs"; recorded by the implementing agent)

specs.description: Score a transcript with all five numbers
specs.given: A transcript with one Bash command matching the scenario's one `expect_verbs` entry (weight 1), one hook-refused call, one call matching a `forbid` pattern, and a `result` record with `num_turns` 1 and `total_cost_usd` 0.01; the outcome command exits 0
specs.when: The scorer runs against a scenario with one expect_verbs entry (weight 1), one forbid pattern, and an outcome command
specs.then: The score is outcome pass, process 1.0, bypasses 1, refusals 1, turns 1, cost 0.01

specs.description: Refuse to score a transcript with a non-JSON line
specs.given: A transcript containing a line that is not valid JSON
specs.when: The scorer attempts to parse the transcript
specs.then: The scorer returns an error naming the line number

specs.description: A valid scenario with all fields
specs.given: A scenario.toml with prompt, setup, expect_verbs, forbid, outcome, outcome_fails_at_start, source, gate_pattern, max_turns, budget_usd
specs.then: The validation passes with no errors

specs.description: A scenario that is already solved is refused
specs.given: A scenario with `outcome_fails_at_start = true` whose `outcome` command already exits 0 on the fixture
specs.then: The scenario fails as vacuous, before any model runs

specs.description: A refused call never counts as a match, edit, gate, or bypass
specs.given: A transcript where a Bash command is refused by a hook
specs.then: The refused call is counted only as a refusal and is excluded from all other tallies

specs.description: A direct source edit before any gate is a bypass
specs.given: A transcript where a model runs 'sed -i s/a/b/ src/x.rs' before running 'hexa loop gate'
specs.then: The sed command is counted as a bypass

specs.description: A command that only names a source path is not a write
specs.when: The scorer checks if the command writes to source
specs.then: The command is not counted as a source edit

specs.given: A run of 'hexa eval run' with a model and timestamp
specs.then: One file `.hexa/evals/<timestamp>-<model>.json` holds one row per scenario with the five numbers, the stop reason and the path of the saved transcript `.hexa/evals/<timestamp>-<model>/<scenario>.jsonl`

specs.description: Do not modify the repository outside .hexa/evals
specs.given: A run of 'hexa eval run' in a repository

specs.description: Run a model with opt-in permission
specs.given: A user runs 'hexa eval run' without --dry-run or --score
specs.then: The model is invoked with the scenario's prompt and settings

specs.description: A dry run or a scoring run starts no model
specs.given: `hexa eval run --dry-run`, and `hexa eval run --score` on a saved transcript
specs.then: No `claude` process is started by either

specs.description: A scenario repo is a fresh temporary directory
specs.given: A run of 'hexa eval run' for a scenario
specs.then: The repo is a new temporary directory with the fixture copied in

specs.description: Do not modify the run-from repository
specs.given: A run of 'hexa eval run' in a repository
specs.then: The repository the command was run from is unchanged

specs.description: Every run's file accounts for every scenario
specs.given: Any real run over any set of scenarios
specs.then: Exactly one new file is written under `.hexa/evals/`, with one row per scenario run, and every transcript path in it names a file that exists

specs.description: A model runs only when a person asks for a real run, and only within budget
specs.given: Any invocation of `hexa eval run`, and any value of `inference.budget_usd_per_day`
specs.then: A model is started only when neither `--dry-run` nor `--score` is given, and no scenario starts once the day's spend, counting this run's, has reached the budget
